sources.title: Adapter_Interface_Qwen.ipynb - Colab
sources.snippet: Adding Adapter Support to Qwen 2.5 via Plugin Interface This notebook demonstrates how to add adapter support to a custom or not pre-supported model with the Adapters library's plugin interface. Specifically, we'll be writing a plugin interface for the Qwen 2.5 model and then train an adapter for mathematical reasoning.
